guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice shows by far the largest latency shift (latency-90 +5011%, latency-50 +2420%) alongside CPU +563%, sockets +535% and memory +58%, while its only callee productcatalogservice is flat (latency-50 +20%, CPU -9%), so the fault originates in recommendationservice itself. The worst traces all pass through recommendationservice at ~3.8-4.0 s and frontend errors and latency rise downstream; the CPU spike is the most direct resource signature, though the socket increase is also large and could instead indicate a socket fault, and no logs exist to disambiguate.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect recommendationservice CPU usage and throttling, then raise its CPU limit or add replicas to relieve the saturation; if socket counts keep climbing after CPU recovers, check for connection leaks. Restarting the pod is not required for the diagnosis.
